name: JSCVMSegmentState
contract: Borrowed persistent slots, no allocation or callback in native segments; original slow opcode runs once after a guard exit. No JSStackFrame/JSAsyncFunctionState/context/runtime/object layout change.
dispatch: 256 ordinary readonly absolute targets in .rdata$cvm_segments, each with a validated PE DIR64 fixup; one indirect indexed branch
boundary_lifetime: Immutable bases initialized once per resume activation. PC/SP alone synchronized at each native segment boundary.
dispatch_topology: Each handler tail reads the next opcode and jumps directly through the readonly table; the central site serves initial entry only.

backend_policy.mingw: original inherited interpreter entry; dedicated coroutine resume and native opcode provider omitted
backend_policy.msvc: Independently compiled persistent resume, original core compiler input unchanged; one verified async_func_resume callee relocation. Callback-free native handler segments.
